une_premiere_lecture_de_votre_ciel_de_na: A first reading of your birth chart, designed to help you better understand the major forces that shape your personality.
chaque_naissance_correspond_a_un_instant: Each birth corresponds to a unique moment. At the exact moment of your arrival in the world, the planets occupied a precise position in the sky. This configuration forms your astrological chart: a symbolic map of your personality, your natural impulses, and your major inner tendencies.
ce_rapport_essentiel_vous_offre_une_prem: This Essential report offers you a clear and accessible first reading of your birth chart. It highlights your three main astrological pillars — the Sun, the Moon, and the Ascendant — as well as the main planets that influence the way you think, love, act, and evolve.
l_astrologie_ne_fige_pas_votre_destin_et: Astrology does not fix your destiny and does not replace your free will. It acts rather as a symbolic mirror: it helps you better understand your strengths, sensitivities, contradictions, and the paths that allow you to grow with greater awareness.
certaines_pages_vous_sembleront_immediat: Some pages may feel immediately familiar to you. Others may make more sense over time. Let your reading unfold naturally, without trying to analyze everything at once.
votre_theme_natal_n_est_pas_une_limite_c: Your natal chart is not a limit. It is an invitation to better know yourself, to recognize your light, and to move forward with more clarity on your own path.
votre_carte_du_ciel_ne_decide_pas_a_votr: Your birth chart does not decide for you. It reveals the forces with which you can create your life.
ce_que_vous_decouvrirez_dans_ce_rapport: What you will discover in this report
vos_trois_grands_piliers_le_soleil_la_lu: ✦ Your three main pillars: the Sun, the Moon, and the Ascendant.
le_role_des_dix_planetes_et_leur_influen: ✦ The role of the ten planets and their influence on your personality.
la_repartition_de_vos_elements_feu_terre: ✦ The distribution of your elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
vos_modalites_dominantes_et_leur_maniere: ✦ Your dominant modalities and how they shape your temperament.
une_synthese_de_votre_profil_astrologiqu: ✦ A synthesis of your astrological profile to better understand your natural strengths.
